# Radar icons and blips

<!-- Generated by `coney-tools refs render` from research/references/radar-icons.yaml. Do not edit. -->

The icon ids `HUDSetRadarItemTexture` takes and the code sets, and the radar's blip types
([GUI: radar](../research/gui.md#radar-icons)).

!!! info "What is complete"

    Every icon a script or the code uses and every blip type the code adds are listed. The numbers are
    read from the code and the scripts; what each icon marks is inferred from who uses it. Classes are the
    character class byte `CfgChar` sets (`+0x11a`, [AI](../research/ai.md#types)).

31 entries. Data: `research/references/radar-icons.yaml`.

## Fields

| Field | Type | Hand-written | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | str | | Our stable id: `icon-<n>` for an icon, `blip-<n>` for a blip type. |
| `kind` | str | | `icon` (a radar icon id) or `blip type` (the kind of blip the radar adds). |
| `number` | int | | The icon id `HUDSetRadarItemTexture` takes, or the blip type number. |
| `sheet` | str | | The sprite sheet the icon is a rectangle of. |
| `rect` | int | | The rectangle's index in that sheet (for an icon, the icon id itself). |
| `size` | list | | The rectangle's size in texels {w, h}, read from the disc. |
| `icon` | int | | For a blip type: the icon it starts with (69 when none is set). |
| `batch` | str | | For a blip type: the radar's sprite batch it is drawn in. |
| `set_by` | str | | Where the game itself sets or uses the number. |
| `scale` | float | | The scale the code forces for this icon, if any. |
| `tint` | str | | The colour (`RRGGBBAA`) the code forces for this icon, if any. |
| `swatch` | str | | A swatch of that colour (rendered). |
| `calls` | int | | `HUDSetRadarItemTexture` calls that pass it. |
| `scripts` | list | | The scripts that pass it (at most six). |
| `meaning` | str | yes | What it marks, in our words. |
| `image` | str | | A thumbnail, a path below `docs/references/images/` (`characters/warr_re_cv.png`); set by extract from the files present. |
| `source` | str | yes | Where the entry comes from: a script and binding, an address, a chunk. |
| `evidence` | str | yes | How we know: confirmed-code, confirmed-runtime, inferred or speculative ([evidence levels](../guides/research-workflow.md#evidence-levels)). |
| `notes` | str | yes | Our own short notes. |
